acceptance_predicates.description: A fresh install with no channel argument selects dev and resolves the current protected ASB/TUI main heads.
Install/status/doctor expose exact source commit, tree, and executable digest without raw credentials.
Explicit supported/future channels are routed deterministically and unsupported channels return typed diagnostics without fallback.
Missing development authentication, signatures, and key management never block the prototype; stable/production remain fail-closed.
The disposable cross-repository journey, hosted checks, independent review, and post-merge verification are recorded.

definition_of_done: The exact current-main cross-repository dev-channel qualification passes and is independently verified.
The signed implementation/qualification evidence is recorded in the state repository.
